name: Relaxation massage
summary: Long, slow Swedish strokes with light to medium pressure. For when nothing hurts exactly — you're just wound tight and sleeping badly.
best_for: Stress, poor sleep, a first massage

name: Deep tissue
summary: Slow, firm work into the layers under the surface, with forearms and elbows where they help. Focused on two or three areas rather than everything.
best_for: Desk necks, stubborn knots, lower back

name: Sports and recovery
summary: Stretching, compression, and targeted work on the muscles your sport leans on. Book it two days after a race, or a week before one.

name: Hot stone
summary: Warm basalt stones glide with the oil and rest along the spine, so muscles let go before any pressure arrives. Slow and heavy in the best way.
best_for: Cold hands, winter shoulders, deep rest

name: Prenatal massage
summary: Side-lying on a fully supported table, from the second trimester on. Gentle work for the hips, lower back, and the calves that swell by evening.

name: Lymphatic drainage
summary: Very light, rhythmic work that follows the lymph pathways toward the nodes. Often booked after surgery, once your surgeon has cleared you.
